_about: Shared real-time intent cases. Both resolvers must agree: backend/realtime.py resolve() (tests/test_realtime.py) and Android intel/Realtime.kt resolve() (RealtimeTest). 'needs' = the categories that need live/current retrieval; [] = answer from knowledge and reasoning, no retrieval. Order doesn't matter.
